correctness.rationale: Fix any unordered two leaves and center. Deleting leaves is a bijection with Cayley trees on n-2 vertices. Uniform Prüfer letters give the full designated-box occupancy law of L-2 under C-size bias. Differentiating a_x=(1-1/x)^(x-2) yields a_x decreasing and an all-size covariance bracket ≥5/16. Exhaustive ordered overlap classes derive the second factorial moment; first and second moment expansions yield all three leading variance/covariance constants and the Pearson limit. Actual bundled check.py outputs VERIFY_OK 1076 for all trees n=4,…,8 and additional exact tests n≤350; finite tests are not taken as infinite proof.

value.rationale: The natural symmetry-related unrestricted sibling-leaf-pair count is not determined by total leaf count. The complete size-biased leaf law gives all factorial mixed moments without enumeration and proves positive finite-size dependence and a nonvanishing, numerically explicit correlation. This motivated structural dependence finding goes beyond marginal enumeration or a routine numeric table.
